units: Blender metres, Z up, character faces -Y, +X is her left
units_in_ouak: OUAK's numbers are centimetres: the Prince's waist rests at 26.345 under a node of scale 1, and his clips write it there. Rouge's waist rests at 25.0, so the exporter gives her a waist offset of -1.345 cm (FOLW). The FBX is in metres with every node at scale 1, so it needs a scale of 100 on import to match (unverified in Unity).
